quests.title: Returns at Campsie
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. I am sending back 74 papers a day from Campsie and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Campsie
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. They will drop my Campsie order if I can show $142 of turnover on the other side of the shop by the week of the show. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: $142, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Campsie Round
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. I do the Campsie round from the middle of the news and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. It started small, the way these things do. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Campsie
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. There is a dog on the Campsie round that has had two of my bags and an esky with no lid that was not even mine. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Campsie
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Nine of us at Campsie have gone in on the same numbers since the week of the show and one of us has stopped putting money in. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$74, which is his share since he stopped
I want it said out loud, not in the group chat

quests.title: The Other Agency, Campsie
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The agency at Belmore closed six months before Campsie started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me

quests.title: The Unclaimed Falcon, Castle Hill
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. There has been a car in the Castle Hill yard since a wet Monday with a docket book on the passenger seat and no owner answering. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the car and the plate together
I have to prove I tried before I can move it

quests.title: Storage Fees, Castle Hill
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Now that it is documented, Castle Hill is owed $136 in storage and the only person who can pay it is the person not answering. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: $136, from him or from the scrap
either way it comes off my floor

quests.title: First Year, Castle Hill
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. I am in my first year at Castle Hill and I have to log 67 hours on a job I am not allowed to touch on my own. It started small, the way these things do. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the supplier, two streets over
and get him a coffee, it helps
sign the book and I owe you

quests.title: The Air Line, Castle Hill
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Somebody has been coming into the Castle Hill yard after two in the afternoon to use the air line, and last week they used the compressor as well. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: the ones who think the yard is public
the gate they are getting through

quests.title: My Own Car, Castle Hill
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. My car has been at Castle Hill since a wet Monday and every time I ring, the quote has grown by about $67. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: stand in the office where they can see you
the job card on the wall, all of it
now I know what I am arguing about

quests.title: The Assessor, Castle Hill
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The insurance assessor who signs off every job at Castle Hill works out of Hills Showground, and he has never once seen the car he is assessing. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: catch him before he goes out on the road
I want to hear how he does it

quests.title: Dumped Out the Back, Gymea
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. People leave things at the Gymea roller door after two in the afternoon and by morning it is rained on and it is our problem and our tip fee. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the pile, on a bad morning
the council will not act without one of these

quests.title: The Tip Fee, Gymea
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. The photos worked, which means Gymea can claim back the $42 we have paid to throw away other people's furniture since a Tuesday. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: $42, and every receipt counts
I will do the form if you do the walking

quests.title: The Good Box, Gymea
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Something came into Gymea on a Tuesday in a box of paperbacks that I do not think the family meant to give away. It started small, the way these things do. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the address on the donation slip
the thing itself, before it goes back
I would rather give it back than sell it

quests.title: Sorting Room, Gymea
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Two people have been coming into the Gymea sorting room since a Tuesday and taking the good stock before it reaches the floor, and one of them volunteers here. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: catch them at the back door
$31, which is what the good stock made last month

quests.title: The Van, Gymea
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. I do the Gymea pick-ups in a van with 31 thousand on it and a door that only opens if you know about it. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: come out to Kirrawee with me, it is a two-person lift
we will stop on the way, my shout

quests.title: Head Office, Gymea
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Everything Gymea cannot sell goes to a warehouse at Kirrawee, and nobody there has ever answered a phone in my hearing. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: turn up in person, that is the trick
tell me there is a person in there
